|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Death Star: Docking Control Room 327 (Virtual Set 23)]] (version 2 of 2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Death Star: Docking Control Room 327 (Virtual Set 23)]] (published 21 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Death Star: Docking Control Room 327 (LIGHT)”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings).
